title: Vertical buyer persona model-gap recon & probe playbook
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Objective: Create an operational playbook that maps buyer personas across three high-priority verticals (fintech, healthcare SaaS, and customer support platforms) to concrete model capability gaps, prioritized probe experiments, and a trigger-driven monitoring plan for continuous competitive signal collection.

Background: Product has many overlapping PM artifacts that track model availability and pricing; however, we lack a buyer-focused decomposition that translates model-level signals (latency, hallucination modes, embeddings stability) into go/no-go thresholds for product bundles and fallback strategies. Sales and solutions engineering have asked for a concise decision canvas to accelerate procurement and POC conversations.

Goal: Deliver a reproducible playbook with (1) persona-to-capability matrices, (2) prioritized probe matrix (model x probe x success criteria), (3) probing runbook for automated and manual tests, and (4) monitoring triggers mapped to procurement and routing playbooks.
success_metrics: Persona matrices for 3 verticals completed and reviewed by GTM
Probe matrix with at least 18 prioritized experiments (6 per vertical) defined
Automated probe harness integrated into existing benchmarking infra and running nightly
Defined routing/procurement triggers with estimated cost delta for 90th percentile latency vs hosted baseline
approach: 1) Rapid desk research: capture buyer constraints (SLA, compliance, cost tolerance) from sales playbooks and two customer interviews per vertical. 2) Map existing model catalog against persona needs (embedding stability, hallucination risk, token cost). 3) Define prioritized probes that trade off latency, quality, and cost. 4) Implement probe harness as parametrized workloads (short vs long context, RAG sensitivity, embedding drift). 5) Run probes, analyze signals, and publish the playbook + actionable triggers for Console and Sales.
deliverables: Buyer persona capability matrices (fintech, healthcare SaaS, customer support)
Prioritized probe matrix (CSV) with ownership and estimated run cost
Nightly probe dashboard (Grafana link) and a Slack alerting mapping to routing/procurement recommendations
Final playbook doc in Confluence with one-page exec summary for Sales
acceptance_criteria: PM/ENG/SE review and sign-off on persona matrices
Probe harness committed to internal benchmarking repo with CI job
Nightly probes produce signals for latency, semantic-quality (precision/recall on canned prompts), and embedding drift
Routing/procurement triggers documented and validated with cost delta examples
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Probe noise from model non-determinism. Mitigation: use fixed seeds where supported and aggregate across runs.
Risk: Probes may incur non-trivial cloud cost. Mitigation: cap runs per day and use sample slices representative of production traffic.
Risk: Rapid model churn invalidates probe results. Mitigation: include model versioning and schedule weekly re-run for fast-moving providers.
